d.ko: Zero Hour is a tactical FPS with online team-based game play that takes place in a variety of fictional locations interpreted in Bangladesh with Real-life scale & resource management. It brings a grounded, close quarter combat experience to the game.
d.en: Zero Hour is a tactical FPS with online team-based game play that takes place in a variety of fictional locations interpreted in Bangladesh with Real-life scale & resource management. It brings a grounded, close quarter combat experience to the game.
d.zh: 《Zero Hour》是一款战术第一人称射击游戏，采用在线组队游玩的形式，故事发生在孟加拉国的数个虚构地点，运用了写实的战斗规模和资源管理系统，为游戏带来了贴近真实感的近距离战斗体验。
